grounding.principle: Physical reality and causal evidence constrain formal abstraction.
grounding.note: The seven formal stages organize the research architecture after the engineering system boundary, observable quantities and evidence status are stated explicitly.

stages.name: Multilayer Structure
stages.question: How is the coupled infrastructure system structured across layers?

stages.name: Causal Mechanisms
stages.question: By what mechanisms do dependencies transmit effects between system elements?

stages.name: Coupled Hybrid Multiscale Dynamics
stages.question: How do interacting states evolve and propagate disturbance across timescales?

stages.name: Feedback & Control
stages.question: Which admissible feedback and control actions alter system trajectories?

stages.name: Viability
stages.question: Which states and controls keep the system inside required operating constraints?

stages.name: Resilience-to-Sustainability Transformation Interface
stages.question: When does recovery preserve, improve, or undermine long-horizon sustainability?

stages.name: Sustainable Transformation Pathways
stages.question: Which defensible intervention pathways move the system toward more sustainable viable futures?
